references.text: The same principle of impurity by touching objects that an unclean person has sat or lain on, with the same cleansing ritual: wash clothes, bathe in water, and remain unclean until evening.
Basic principle that any bed or object an unclean person lies or sits on becomes unclean.
Parallel text about impurity until evening by touching objects under an unclean person, with identical cleansing procedure.
The same pattern for cleansing: wash clothes and remain unclean until evening upon touching unclean things.
Identical wording about washing clothes, bathing in water, and remaining unclean until evening when touching unclean objects.
Similar cleansing ritual involving washing of clothes and bathing, with impurity until evening.
